Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) is a leading coffee and beverage company in North America, with annual revenue in excess of $11 billion. With a wide range of hot and cold beverages that meet virtually any consumer need, KDP key brands include Keurig®, Dr Pepper®, Green Mountain Coffee Roasters®, Canada Dry®, Snapple®, Bai®, Mott’s® and The Original Donut Shop®. About Association Of American Medical Colleges
----------------------------------------------

The AAMC serves and leads the academic medicine community to improve the health of all. Founded in 1876 and based in Washington, D.C., the Association of American Medical Colleges (AAMC) is a not-for-profit association representing all 141 accredited U.S. and 17 accredited Canadian medical schools; nearly 400 major teaching hospitals and health systems, including 51 Department of Veterans Affairs medical centers; and 90 academic and scientific societies. Through these institutions and organizations, the AAMC represents 148,000 faculty members, 83,000 medical students, and 115,000 resident physicians. Through its many programs and services, the AAMC strengthens the world's most advanced medical care by supporting the entire spectrum of education, research, and patient care activities conducted by their member institutions. The AAMC and their members are dedicated to the communities they serve and steadfast in their desire to earn and keep the public's trust for the role they play in improving the nation's health.

What types of flower subscriptions does Freddie's Flowers offer?

Freddie's Flowers offers a variety of flower subscription options to cater to different preferences and budgets. Customers can choose from weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly deliveries. What should I do if my flowers arrive damaged or wilted?

About Bates White Economic Consulting
-------------------------------------

Bates White Economic Consulting offers services to law firms, Fortune 500 companies, and government agencies. We specialize in advanced economic, financial, and econometric analysis and excel at complex matters that require sophisticated problem solving and deep empirical analysis. Established in 1999 and privately held, we have a culture where bright minds from diverse cultures solve difficult challenges. We build strong, collaborative relationships with our clients, within our team, and in the community. Our firm is distinguished by the strength of our collective experiences—intellectual and analytical rigor, creativity, responsiveness, and practical know-how. In each matter, we take a hands-on approach to develop a deep understanding of relevant industry, factual, and legal contexts. We are consistently recognized for an ability to support our opinions with sound economic theory and rigorous empirical analyses that withstand intense scrutiny. Our experts are noted for their ability to communicate clearly, succinctly, and persuasively to litigators, judges, juries, and government enforcers. With extensive experience in the application of economics to a wide range of industries and issues, most of our professionals hold PhD or master’s level degrees. We complement our in-house expertise through an extensive network of leading academics and industry experts. Many of our senior staff and academic affiliates have significant government agency experience.

Adelphoi Ketterer Charter School provides education to Adelphoi Village youth, along with students of local school districts. Homes Build Hope offers affordable housing to individuals and families in need. Adelphoi Education provides education services to youth who are struggling in the traditional classroom setting. Adelphoi Foundation serves as the conduit for all philanthropic support and manages a systematic program of donor stewardship. Together, these organizations form a wide continuum of services for those most in need in the community.

What types of industries does H-E Parts International serve?

H-E Parts International primarily serves the global mining, quarry, and heavy construction industries. Our expertise extends to various sectors, including industrial engineering, manufacturing, and equipment maintenance solutions. What remanufactured components does H-E Parts offer?

H-E Parts offers a wide range of remanufactured components designed for heavy machinery used in mining and construction. Our remanufactured parts include crushers, shovels, and other essential mining machinery components. Each part undergoes rigorous testing and quality assurance processes to ensure optimal performance and reliability.

Can H-E Parts assist with equipment maintenance and consulting?

Yes, H-E Parts provides comprehensive equipment maintenance solutions and consulting services. Our team of experts can assess your equipment's condition, recommend maintenance strategies, and help implement solutions to improve efficiency and reduce downtime. We focus on maximizing the lifespan and performance of your heavy machinery.

What is the process for asset disposal at H-E Parts?

H-E Parts offers asset disposal services that include the evaluation, refurbishment, and resale of used equipment. Our team helps clients identify equipment that is no longer needed and provides options for responsible disposal or resale, ensuring compliance with environmental regulations and maximizing recovery value.

How does H-E Parts support equipment relocation services?

H-E Parts provides specialized equipment relocation services to ensure safe and efficient transport of heavy machinery. Our experienced team manages all aspects of the relocation process, including logistics planning, disassembly, transportation, and reassembly at the new site. We prioritize minimizing downtime and ensuring equipment integrity during the move.

What types of mining wear parts does H-E Parts supply?

H-E Parts supplies a comprehensive range of mining wear parts designed to withstand the harsh conditions of the mining industry. Our offerings include wear liners, buckets, and other critical components that enhance the durability and performance of mining equipment. We focus on delivering high-quality products that meet the specific needs of our clients.

About Taber Extrusions
----------------------

Taber Extrusions’ specialty is the manufacturing of complex and intricate aluminum extrusions which competitors consider difficult or even impossible. With applications in the military and defense, aircraft and aerospace, transportation, automotive, architectural, sporting goods, and naval marine industries Taber products can be customized for virtually any application.  
  
Taber Extrusions is a full-service partner, offering custom aluminum alloy casting, award-winning extrusion of complex, heavy, and wide shapes, and finishing services such as cut-to-length, welding, painting and anodizing, ultrasonic testing, and more. We have an unwavering commitment to consistently meeting and exceeding customer expectations by providing both products and service of the highest quality.  
  
For us, the unique, customized capabilities are key. Our full range of extrusion presses, from 1800 and 3000 ton to our impressive large 8600 ton, give us unmatched flexibility and profile capabilities. For example: one of the largest extrusion presses in the United States, our 8600 ton press, has the capability to extrude both 16 and 20 inch round billets, and 10” x 28” rectangular billets with a maximum circle size of 32” and up to 140 lbs. per foot. With the ability to extrude large, intricate configurations, such as lightweight but strong one-piece extrusions, the customer can incorporate whole assemblies of small components into one extruded part.  
  
Minority owned and ISO-9001 certified, Taber's value added philosophy, along with our custom capabilities and top-tier customer service, is why Taber Extrusions has been a leader in the extrusion industry for over four decades.

The Plum lightpad lets control your home lighting without the need for any additional hardware, gateway or bridge. It's a smart dimmer that's designed to fit any North American light switch receptacle with no modifications. Simply remove your current switch and wire in the lightpad with just four wires.  
  
The lightpad contains an high performance processor, open source API, an advanced operating system, and a full IP stack. It uses the same Wi-Fi security as the other devices on your home network including WEP, WPA and WPA2. Any information that is sent between the Plum app, the lightpad and your cloud service is securely encrypted.  
  
There's an energy meter inside every Plum lightpad, smart plug and smart outlet. The Plum app allows you to track and monitor everything attached to a Plum product. About Companhia Siderúrgica do Pecém - CSP
------------------------------------------

Nós da CSP - Companhia Siderúrgica do Pecém - somos a primeira siderúrgica integrada do Ceará, ou seja, produzimos o aço desde a sua matéria prima e já exportamos para mais de 20 países. Representamos aproximadamente 70% de tudo que é exportado pelo Porto do Pecém.Nossos números são resultado do trabalho de toda a equipe, que conta com mais de 2500 empregados, sendo 62% cearenses, que aprendem a trabalhar na siderurgia com o passar dos anos, desde a nossa instalação no Estado.Estamos em São Gonçalo do Amarante, no Ceará, localização estratégica para as exportações e um grande orgulho para nós. Somos uma joint venture binacional formada pela brasileira Vale, e as sul-coreanas Dungkuk e Posco. Somos instalados em uma área de 901 hectares, dentro da Zona de Processamento de Exportação do Ceará (ZPE-CE).Na nossa região, desenvolvemos programas de sustentabilidade social que rendem ótimos resultados as comunidades que são nossas vizinhas. Programa Território Empreendedor, Jovem Aprendiz, Ideia da Gente entre outros de diálogo com as comunidades que nos permite conhecer melhor esse território e trazer mais oportunidades e crescimento para a região.Já comemoramos o marco de mais de seis milhões de toneladas de placas de aço produzidas. Agora, buscamos crescer ainda mais junto com o nosso Estado e ampliar a participação no mercado mundial.Essa história começou a ser construída ainda em 2008 e está só no começo. Uma trajetória baseada no cuidado com a preservação ambiental e no respeito à região no qual estamos inseridos.Quer saber mais sobre nós e como fazer parte desta história? Acesse nosso site: www.cspecem.com

Since the year 2000, Odyssey Technical Solutions has developed a reputation as the "go to"​ equipment repair company for RF, DC and MW applications in both semiconductor and industrial markets. Odyssey's reputation for quick turnaround times and customer satisfaction has provided it the opportunity to become involved with an array of different processes and equipment within the industry. The Odyssey technology center is a state-of-the-art repair facility, 32,000 square feet, located in Round Rock, Texas. Services can include repair, refurbishment, core exchanges, process and equipment engineering, and equipment sales. Odyssey is an ISO 9001:2015 and ANSI/ESD S20.20 Certified company, and a US veteran-owned company.  
  
Odyssey specializes in RF Generators, Automatch Networks, DC Power Supplies, and Microwave Generators/ Power Supplies. In addition they are the exclusive distributor for the COMET line of fixed and variable vacuum capacitors, enabling you to save time and money on these critical components.

What types of equipment does Odyssey Technical Solutions repair?

Odyssey Technical Solutions specializes in the repair of a wide range of equipment, including RF (Radio Frequency), DC (Direct Current), and MW (Microwave) applications. Our services cover various devices such as RF generators, microwave systems, DC power supplies, and remote plasma sources. We cater to both the semiconductor and industrial markets, ensuring that your equipment is restored to optimal performance.

How does Odyssey ensure the quality of its repair services?

At Odyssey Technical Solutions, we prioritize quality and reliability in our repair services. Our team consists of highly trained technicians with extensive experience in RF, DC, and MW applications. We utilize state-of-the-art diagnostic tools and adhere to strict quality control processes to ensure that each repair meets industry standards. Additionally, we provide thorough testing and validation to guarantee that repaired equipment operates efficiently and safely.

What industries does Odyssey Technical Solutions serve?

Odyssey Technical Solutions serves a diverse range of industries, primarily focusing on the semiconductor and industrial sectors. Our expertise extends to applications in food safety, where we provide specialized repair services for equipment used in food processing and safety compliance. We are committed to supporting various industries by ensuring their critical equipment remains operational and compliant with safety regulations.

Can Odyssey repair equipment from any manufacturer?

Yes, Odyssey Technical Solutions is equipped to repair equipment from various manufacturers. Our technicians are knowledgeable about a wide array of brands and models, allowing us to provide effective repair solutions regardless of the original manufacturer. We understand the unique requirements of different systems and can tailor our services to meet those needs.

What is the typical turnaround time for repairs at Odyssey?

The turnaround time for repairs at Odyssey Technical Solutions can vary depending on the complexity of the repair and the availability of parts. However, we strive to provide timely service and often complete repairs within a few days to a week. For urgent requests, we offer expedited services to minimize downtime. We encourage customers to contact us directly for specific timelines based on their equipment and repair needs.

Does Odyssey provide warranty on its repair services?

Yes, Odyssey Technical Solutions offers a warranty on our repair services. We stand behind the quality of our work and provide a warranty period during which we will address any issues related to the repairs performed. The warranty details may vary based on the type of equipment and the nature of the repair, so we recommend discussing warranty specifics with our team when you submit your equipment for repair.

About Cassandra Calin

Cassandra Calin is an incredibly talented comic artist who has gained a massive following for her relatable and humorous comics. Her work often explores the everyday struggles and awkward moments that many people can relate to, making her comics universally appealing and entertaining.  
  
Calin's illustrations are characterized by their simple yet expressive style, with vibrant colors and clean lines that draw the reader in. Her characters often exude emotion and personality, bringing her comics to life and making them highly engaging. Whether she's portraying a relatable moment of social awkwardness or a humorous observation about everyday life, Calin's unique artistic style adds an extra layer of charm and humor to her work.  
  
One of the most appealing aspects of Calin's comics is their authenticity. She has a knack for capturing the small, often embarrassing moments that we all experience but may be hesitant to talk about. Through her art, Calin creates a sense of camaraderie among her readers, reminding them that they are not alone in their everyday struggles and insecurities. Her ability to find humor in the ordinary and mundane has endeared her to a global audience, making her comics a source of comfort and laughter for many.  
  
In addition to her relatable content, Calin's comics also carry a strong message of self-acceptance and empowerment. She often addresses issues such as body image, mental health, and self-confidence in her work, approaching these topics with humor and sensitivity. By sharing her own experiences and insecurities, Calin encourages her readers to embrace their flaws and imperfections, promoting a message of self-love and empowerment that resonates deeply with many.  
  
Societal norms, gender roles, and the complexities of modern relationships are also common themes in Calin's work. Through her comics, she challenges stereotypes, breaks down barriers, and opens up conversations about important social issues. Her refreshing approach to these topics, combined with her sharp wit and lighthearted humor, makes her comics both thought-provoking and entertaining.  
  
Another aspect that sets Calin apart as a comic artist is her inclusive and diverse representation of characters. In her comics, readers can find people of varying backgrounds, body types, and identities, reflecting the rich diversity of the real world. At California Business Bank (“CBB”), we combine the best of traditional community banking service, with modern technology origination and delivery methods. Technology when a business owner prefer, a person when they don’t.  
  
We provide innovative financial products and services to small businesses and entrepreneurs, delivered through a distribution network that combines high-touch and high-tech. Our employees strive to add value to every customer interaction, through active listening and creative reasoning.  
  
At California Business Bank, we pride ourselves on going beyond what many consider to be the usual concept of a business bank – a static location that requires clients to come to the bank’s offices. That’s not our idea of service. We turned that concept around and came up with a better one, which we call Bankers in the Field. Now you don’t have to make inconvenient trips to the bank. ### Frequently Asked Questions about Spark.Orange, LLC

What services does Spark.Orange offer as a Salesforce Silver Strategic Implementation Partner?

Spark.Orange specializes in a variety of services related to Salesforce implementation and management. These include management consulting, marketing automation using Pardot, web application development, and API integrations. They also provide tailored solutions for various Salesforce clouds such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Community Cloud, ensuring that businesses can leverage the full potential of the Salesforce platform.

How does Spark.Orange support the higher education sector?

Spark.Orange offers specialized solutions for the higher education sector, focusing on improving student engagement and operational efficiency. Their services include implementing Salesforce solutions that streamline admissions processes, enhance communication with students, and provide analytics to drive decision-making. By leveraging Salesforce's capabilities, Spark.Orange helps educational institutions optimize their operations and improve the overall student experience.

What industries does Spark.Orange serve?

Spark.Orange serves a diverse range of industries, including higher education, manufacturing, and technology. Their expertise in Salesforce implementation allows them to cater to the unique needs of each sector, providing customized solutions that enhance operational efficiency and drive growth. Analytics play a crucial role in Spark.Orange's service offerings, particularly through the use of Salesforce Analytics Cloud. By implementing advanced analytics solutions, Spark.Orange helps businesses gain insights into their operations, customer behaviors, and market trends. This data-driven approach enables organizations to make informed decisions, optimize their strategies, and ultimately improve their performance across various departments.

Can Spark.Orange assist with Salesforce CPQ and Field Service Lightning implementations?

Yes, Spark.Orange has expertise in implementing Salesforce CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) and Field Service Lightning solutions. Their team can help organizations streamline their quoting processes, improve pricing accuracy, and enhance field service operations. By leveraging these Salesforce tools, businesses can achieve greater efficiency, reduce errors, and improve customer satisfaction through timely and accurate service delivery.

How does Spark.Orange approach strategy consulting for its clients?

Spark.Orange takes a comprehensive approach to strategy consulting by first understanding the unique challenges and goals of each client. They work collaboratively to develop tailored strategies that align with the client's objectives, leveraging their expertise in Salesforce and industry best practices. This may involve operations design, process optimization, and technology integration to ensure that clients can achieve sustainable growth and operational excellence.

We build and manage data feeds, helping online retailers to reach more consumers online in more of the most popular channels.  
  
FusePump also uses the technology to offer awesome ecommerce intelligence and marketing insights to brands, and we can also gather product offers data from retail partners to give back to manufacturers, to help them play a more central role in marketing their own products online. It's all very clever.  
  
And how do we do all this? I'm so glad you asked. We have some pretty brilliant technology (that enables us to access a lot of data, and to do cool stuff with it) but the important thing is that we have really great people. Our technical crew perform miraculous optimisation wizardry while our commercial team provide astonishingly helpful service to customers.  
  
So do get in touch if you want to chat about how we can help consumers find (and buy) your products on the world wide wigwam.

About Ratana Home and Floral

Since our inception in 1980, Ratana has offered quality craftsmanship and timeless designs of outdoor furnishings.  
  
Inspired by legendary landscapes, Ratana debuted a range of furniture from traditional to contemporary in style, designed to blend form and function with ease. Ratana has been the outdoor living furniture brand of choice for homes, and their comprehensive collection of contract and hospitality specification furniture can be found around the world in 5-star luxury hotels and restaurants that care about the integrity of design and structure.  
  
Using the most innovative design technology, Ratana’s collection has grown to include home furnishing collections that seamlessly integrate into your lifestyle and elevate your aesthetic experience. Ratana’s quality aluminum furniture sets the industry standard and is structured to weather outdoor conditions for years to come - one of the many reasons why they are the company of choice for so many large hospitality groups. Ratana makes outdoor living a luxurious experience and it respects the environment it dwells in as well.  
  
Ratana has remained family owned and prides itself on a legacy which has seen them building relationships that continued to thrive over generations. Their commitment to exemplary customer service is at the core of the company and this mindset has enabled them to maintain long-standing relationships with several families, small and large companies and hospitality groups around the world.  
  
Ratana can be found worldwide and offices and showrooms in both North America and Asia.  
  
For the latest news and information, visit www.ratana.com or follow @RatanaFurniture on Instagram and Facebook.

What types of projects does Northstar Project & Real Estate Services specialize in?

Northstar Project & Real Estate Services specializes in a wide range of projects, focusing primarily on real estate development and project management. Our expertise spans various sectors, including institutional, higher education, and life sciences. We handle everything from capital planning and development management to building repositioning and land use planning.

How does Northstar approach risk management in its projects?

At Northstar, we prioritize risk management as a critical component of our project management process. Our team conducts thorough risk assessments during the planning phase and continuously monitors potential risks throughout the project lifecycle. By employing strategies such as risk mitigation planning and regular stakeholder communication, we ensure that projects stay on track and within budget.

What services does Northstar offer for higher education institutions?

Northstar provides tailored project management and advisory services specifically for higher education institutions. Our offerings include capital planning, feasibility studies, and project execution for campus development projects. We work closely with educational stakeholders to ensure that projects align with institutional goals and enhance the overall campus experience for students and faculty.

Can Northstar assist with pre-acquisition due diligence?

Yes, Northstar offers comprehensive pre-acquisition due diligence services. Our team evaluates potential real estate investments by conducting market analysis, financial assessments, and risk evaluations. This thorough approach helps clients make informed decisions and identify opportunities for maximizing the value of their investments.

What is the process for building repositioning services at Northstar?

Our building repositioning services begin with a detailed analysis of the existing property and its market potential. We assess factors such as location, current use, and market demand to develop a repositioning strategy. This may involve renovations, rebranding, or repurposing the space to better meet market needs. Our goal is to enhance property value and attract new tenants or buyers.

What industries does Northstar serve beyond real estate development?

In addition to real estate development, Northstar serves a variety of industries, including life sciences, institutional clients, and commercial sectors. Our diverse expertise allows us to adapt our project management and advisory services to meet the unique needs of each industry, ensuring successful project outcomes and client satisfaction.

About GKN Driveline
-------------------

GKN Automotive is a world-leading global automotive technology company that pioneered electric drive systems and is now driving the future of transportation. Its origins date back to 1759, and for the last 70 years it has been at the forefront of the automotive industry, putting key technologies into series production. It is the trusted partner for most of the world’s automotive companies, specialising in developing, building, and supplying market-leading driveline systems and advanced ePowertrain technologies. It is the global leader in sideshafts, with eight out of ten of the world’s best-selling cars using its sideshaft technology. The first eDrive system was fitted to a production car over 20 years ago and GKN Automotive is now powering over two million electrified vehicles worldwide.  
GKN Automotive is part of Dowlais, a specialist engineering group focused on the automotive sector.

### Frequently Asked Questions about FarmLogs

What features does FarmLogs offer for farm management?

FarmLogs provides a comprehensive suite of features designed to help row crop farmers manage their operations efficiently. Key features include digital farm records management, crop planning, field mapping, weather tracking, and yield monitoring. The platform also offers tools for financial management, allowing farmers to track expenses and revenues, and generate reports to analyze their farm's performance.

How does FarmLogs help with data analysis and decision-making?

FarmLogs helps farmers make data-driven decisions by providing meaningful insights derived from their farm data. The software aggregates various data points, such as weather patterns, soil conditions, and crop performance, allowing farmers to visualize trends and make informed choices about planting, irrigation, and harvesting. Additionally, the app's reporting features enable users to assess their operations' profitability and identify areas for improvement.

Is FarmLogs suitable for small-scale farmers, or is it designed for larger operations?

FarmLogs is designed to be versatile and user-friendly, making it suitable for both small-scale and larger farming operations. The app's features can be tailored to meet the specific needs of different farm sizes, allowing small farmers to manage their operations effectively without being overwhelmed by complexity. Its cost-effective pricing model also makes it accessible for farmers with varying budgets.

Can I access FarmLogs on mobile devices?

Yes, FarmLogs is available as both a mobile app and a desktop application. This allows farmers to access their farm management tools on-the-go, whether they are in the field or at home. The mobile app provides real-time updates and notifications, ensuring that users can stay informed about their farm's status and make timely decisions.

What types of crops does FarmLogs support?

FarmLogs primarily focuses on row crop farming, supporting a variety of crops including corn, soybeans, wheat, and other similar crops. The platform is designed to cater to the unique needs of row crop farmers, providing specialized tools and resources to help them optimize their production and manage their operations effectively.

How does FarmLogs integrate with other agricultural technologies?

FarmLogs is designed to integrate seamlessly with various agricultural technologies and tools. This includes compatibility with precision agriculture equipment, satellite imagery services, and other farm management software. By integrating with these technologies, FarmLogs enhances its capabilities, allowing farmers to consolidate their data and streamline their operations for better efficiency and productivity.

Allison Bechdel is an American cartoonist whose groundbreaking work has had a profound impact on the world of comics and graphic novels. Born in 1960 in Pennsylvania, Bechdel began her career in the 1980s, creating a series of comic strips that would eventually lead to her most famous work, the graphic novel "Fun Home: A Family Tragicomic."  
  
Bechdel's early work as a cartoonist was defined by its sharp wit, incisive social commentary, and unapologetic exploration of LGBTQ+ themes. Her comic strip "Dykes to Watch Out For" ran from 1983 to 2008, and it was through this series that Bechdel honed her distinctive artistic style and voice. "Dykes to Watch Out For" was celebrated for its complex characters, compelling storylines, and fearless exploration of issues such as queer identity, feminism, and politics.  
  
In 2006, Bechdel published "Fun Home," a deeply personal and poignant memoir that delved into her complicated relationship with her father, who was a closeted gay man and the owner of a funeral home. The graphic novel was a critical and commercial success, receiving widespread acclaim for its powerful storytelling, nuanced character development, and masterful use of the graphic format to convey emotional depth. "Fun Home" was also a finalist for the National Book Critics Circle Award and was adapted into a widely praised Broadway musical in 2015.  
  
In addition to her work as a cartoonist, Bechdel has been a vocal advocate for LGBTQ+ rights and representation in the arts. Her body of work has contributed to a broader cultural shift in the visibility and acceptance of queer narratives in mainstream media, and she has been recognized as a trailblazer in the field of LGBTQ+ literature.  
  
Bechdel's impact on the world of comics and graphic novels cannot be overstated. Her work has inspired a new generation of storytellers to explore complex, diverse narratives and to push the boundaries of the medium. She has also been a mentor and role model for many aspiring cartoonists, particularly those who are marginalized or underrepresented in the industry.

About Samuel Pepys

Samuel Pepys was an English diarist, naval administrator, and Member of Parliament, best known for his detailed and personal diary that he kept from 1660 to 1669. Pepys’ diary provides a fascinating insight into the social, political, and cultural life of 17th-century England, capturing the tumultuous events of the time, including the Restoration of the monarchy, the Great Plague of London, and the Great Fire of London. Over the course of nine years, Pepys meticulously documented his daily life, revealing his thoughts, feelings, and experiences, as well as his interactions with notable figures of the period.  
  
Born in London on February 23, 1633, Samuel Pepys was the son of a tailor and a butcher's daughter. He was educated at St. Paul's School, London, and later studied at Magdalene College, Cambridge. Despite his humble background, Pepys climbed the ranks of society and eventually became one of the most powerful men in England, holding various official positions, including Clerk of the Acts to the Navy Board and Secretary to the Admiralty. His rise to prominence allowed him to witness and participate in many significant events, and his firsthand accounts provide invaluable historical evidence of the time.  
  
Pepys began his diary on January 1, 1660, shortly before the restoration of the monarchy under King Charles II. The diary is written in a clear, straightforward style, with Pepys using shorthand to ensure privacy. In it, he records his daily activities, ranging from mundane tasks to momentous occasions, such as royal visits and naval engagements. His entries also encompass his personal relationships, including his marriage to Elisabeth de St. Michel, his extramarital affairs, and his friendships with influential figures, such as Sir William Coventry and Sir George Downing.  
  
One of the most notable aspects of Pepys’ diary is its vivid depiction of the Great Plague of London, which struck the city in 1665. Pepys provided a chilling and detailed account of the devastation caused by the plague, describing the mounting death toll, the breakdown of social order, and the harrowing scenes he witnessed. His descriptions convey the fear, despair, and resilience of Londoners in the face of an unprecedented calamity, offering a deeply human perspective on a momentous event in British history.  
  
Another pivotal event captured in Pepys’ diary is the Great Fire of London in 1666, which ravaged the city for four days, destroying thousands of homes and buildings. Pepys’ diary provides a gripping firsthand account of the fire, documenting the chaos, confusion, and desperation of the inhabitants, as well as the efforts to contain the blaze and rebuild the city in its aftermath. His descriptions of the fire’s progress, the destruction it caused, and the impact on the community offer a compelling insight into a defining moment in London’s history.  
  
Pepys’ diary came to an end in 1669, and it remained unpublished until the 19th century. Today, the diary is celebrated as a literary and historical treasure, offering a unique window into the past and a wealth of information for scholars and enthusiasts alike. It provides rich material for understanding the everyday life of 17th-century England, as well as the political, social, and cultural milieu in which Pepys lived. His diary is widely regarded as one of the most important and evocative primary sources for the period, offering valuable perspectives on the Restoration, the Stuart monarchy, and the everyday experiences of people from different walks of life.  
  
In addition to his diary, Pepys was a prolific writer and collector, amassing a vast library of books and manuscripts, as well as a renowned collection of naval documents and artifacts. His passion for learning and scholarship is evident in his wide-ranging interests, and he made significant contributions to the fields of naval administration, music, and theatre. Pepys was also a dedicated patron of the arts, supporting playwrights and musicians, and his influence extended to the cultural life of his time.  
  
Samuel Pepys’ legacy endures through his diary and his contributions to English literature and history. His candid, observant, and introspective writing style continues to captivate readers, offering a firsthand account of a pivotal period in British history. Pepys’ diary stands as a remarkable testament to the power of personal testimony and the enduring relevance of individual experiences in shaping our understanding of the past. His diary has been the subject of numerous adaptations, including stage plays, television series, and scholarly editions, attesting to its enduring appeal and significance in the literary and historical canon. Pepys’ remarkable life and legacy continue to inspire and intrigue, making him a lasting figure in the annals of English history and literature.

About Samuel Peckinpah

Samuel Peckinpah was an American film director and screenwriter known for his innovative and controversial work in the Western genre. Born in 1925 in Fresno, California, Peckinpah grew up with a deep love for the American West, which would later become a recurring theme in his films. After serving in the Marine Corps during World War II, Peckinpah attended California State University, where he studied literature and drama before pursuing a career in the film industry.  
  
Peckinpah's career in Hollywood began in the 1950s, where he worked as a writer and assistant director on various television programs. It wasn't until the early 1960s that he got his big break as a director with the film "The Deadly Companions," which featured his unique take on the traditional Western narrative. However, it was his 1962 film "Ride the High Country" that garnered him critical acclaim and solidified his reputation as a filmmaker to watch.  
  
Throughout the 1960s and 1970s, Peckinpah continued to push the boundaries of the Western genre, often incorporating controversial themes and graphic violence into his films. One of his most iconic works, "The Wild Bunch," released in 1969, shocked audiences with its gritty portrayal of outlaws in the final days of the Wild West. The film's innovative use of slow-motion and quick-cut editing techniques set a new standard for action sequences in cinema.  
  
Peckinpah's reputation as a maverick filmmaker was further solidified with the release of "Straw Dogs" in 1971, a psychological thriller that explored the themes of violence and masculinity in a small English village. The film was met with both praise and controversy for its graphic portrayal of brutality, sparking intense debates about the ethical responsibility of filmmakers. Despite the controversy, "Straw Dogs" remains a seminal work in Peckinpah's filmography and a testament to his willingness to challenge societal norms.  
  
In addition to his work in the Western and thriller genres, Peckinpah also delved into other genres, such as the war film "Cross of Iron" and the dystopian drama "The Osterman Weekend." Despite his eclectic body of work, Peckinpah's films were often united by their bleak and uncompromising exploration of human violence and morality. His unapologetic approach to storytelling made him a polarizing figure in the film industry, with some celebrating his boundary-pushing vision while others condemned his work as exploitative and nihilistic.  
  
Unfortunately, Peckinpah's career was marked by personal struggles, including battles with alcoholism and conflicts with studio executives. Despite his tumultuous professional life, his influence on the cinematic landscape cannot be overstated. His legacy continues to inspire filmmakers to this day, with directors such as Quentin Tarantino citing him as a major influence on their work.  
  
Samuel Peckinpah's impact on American cinema is undeniable, and his uncompromising vision continues to resonate with audiences and filmmakers alike. His willingness to challenge conventions and push the boundaries of storytelling has left an indelible mark on the Western genre and beyond. As a filmmaker, Peckinpah's dedication to exploring the complexities of human nature and morality set him apart as a true maverick in the industry. His legacy as an innovative and controversial filmmaker endures, ensuring that his work will continue to provoke, inspire, and challenge audiences for generations to come.

About The City College of New York
----------------------------------

Since 1847, The City College of New York has provided a high quality and affordable education to generations of New Yorkers in a wide variety of disciplines. CCNY embraces its role at the forefront of social change. It is ranked #1 by The Chronicle of Higher Education out of 369 selective public colleges in the United States on the overall mobility index. This measure reflects both access and outcomes, representing the likelihood that a student at CCNY can move up two or more income quintiles. In addition, the Center for world University Rankings places CCNY in the top 1.2% of universities worldwide in terms of academic excellence. More than 16,000 students pursue undergraduate and graduate degrees in eight professional schools and divisions, driven by significant funded research, creativity and scholarship. CCNY is as diverse, dynamic and visionary as New York City itself.  
  
Outstanding programs in architecture, engineering, education and the liberal arts and sciences prepare our students for the future, and produce outstanding leaders in every field. Whether they are drawn to the traditional, like philosophy or sociology, or emerging fields like sonic arts or biomedical engineering, our baccalaureate graduates go on to graduate programs at Stanford, Columbia or MIT – or they stay right here in one of our 50 master's programs or our doctoral programs in engineering, the laboratory sciences, and psychology.  
  
Nowhere else in the city do undergraduates have so many opportunities to conduct research with professors and publish and present their findings. In our science, engineering and social science programs, more than 300 undergrads work alongside senior researchers in funded projects.  
  
Leading CUNY in funded research, we house a number of research centers.

About The University of Texas Health Science Center at Houston
--------------------------------------------------------------

The University of Texas Health Science Center at Houston (UTHealth Houston) educates the largest number of health care professionals in Texas. Created in 1972 by The University of Texas System Board of Regents, UTHealth Houston is located in the Texas Medical Center. It includes the schools of dentistry, biomedical informatics, medicine, nursing, public health, and the graduate school of biomedical sciences. UTHealth Houston is accredited by the Commission on Colleges of the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools to award certificate, bachelor's, master's, doctoral, and professional degrees. Three faculty practices treat patients in a variety of Houston-area clinics: UT Physicians, UT Dentists, and UT Health Services.

------------

Kaplan is a global educational services company that provides individuals, universities, and businesses with a diverse array of services, including higher and professional education, test preparation, language training, corporate and leadership training, and student recruitment, online enablement and other university support services.  
  
Our company was founded in 1938 in Stanley Kaplan’s Brooklyn, NY home with a mission to help children of immigrants advance their dream of going to college. From those humble beginnings, Kaplan has grown into an enterprise operating in 28 countries and serving nearly a million students and thousands of corporate and university clients.  
  
Throughout our history, Kaplan has remained committed to our founding mission of expanding educational access and transforming learning through new technologies. We are always moving forward—innovating, adapting, and bringing education into the future. The vast breadth and scale of our capabilities and diverse offerings set us apart, allowing our students and partners to advance further, faster.  
  
Kaplan is a subsidiary of the Graham Holdings Company.

Missguided is a global fashion powerhouse, inspired by millennial women who are like-minded rebels that champion freedom of expression. Missguided is an inclusive movement open to all. We believe our audience is defined by a state of mind rather than a specific grouping or label.  
  
Our purpose: To empower all women by inspiring self confidence in mind, body and potential.  
  
Missguided is one of the fastest growing women’s online retailers in the world. Founded in 2009 in the UK by Nitin Passi, it has become a leading fashion retailer, taking an agile approach that sees it deliver commercial and affordable product to its customers before trends hit.  
  
Its signature confident style and broad product range has driven global development in recent years, now selling to over 180 countries and locally active in the UK, US, Australia, France, Spain, Ireland, Poland and Germany, with future plans for further international expansion and a loyal following of over 9 million social media fans worldwide across multiple platforms.  
  
Missguided have further developed their global profile and growth through numerous wholesale opportunities with established brands such as ASOS, Zalando, The Iconic, Nelly, and Namshi and a growing number of franchise stores across the world, including a flagship at Dubai Mall, Dubai and Tel Aviv.

About Jacqueline Wilson

Jacqueline Wilson is a renowned English novelist who has captivated the hearts of readers around the world with her captivating storytelling and relatable characters. Born on December 17, 1945, in Bath, Somerset, Wilson showed an early passion for writing and storytelling. Her childhood was not without its challenges, as she struggled with dyslexia and suffered from the effects of her parents' tumultuous marriage. However, these experiences would ultimately shape her writing and fuel her determination to create stories that resonated with young readers.  
  
Wilson's literary career began in the 1970s when she started working as a journalist for publications such as Jackie magazine. However, it was her transition to writing children's books that would cement her status as a beloved author. Her debut novel, "Lola Rose," was published in 1999 and marked the beginning of a prolific and successful career in children's literature. Since then, Wilson has written over 100 books, many of which have become bestsellers and have been translated into numerous languages.  
  
One of the hallmarks of Wilson's writing is her ability to tackle complex and sensitive issues in a way that is accessible to young readers. She's unafraid to explore topics such as family breakdown, mental health, and bullying, and her books often provide a safe space for children to navigate these difficult subjects. Through her vivid characters and poignant storytelling, Wilson has empowered countless children to feel seen and heard, offering them a sense of validation and empathy.  
  
Wilson's influence extends beyond her imaginative and thought-provoking storytelling. She has also been a vocal advocate for children's literacy and mental health awareness, using her platform to raise awareness of these important issues. Wilson has served as the UK Children's Laureate and has been awarded numerous prestigious honors for her contributions to children's literature, including the OBE (Order of the British Empire) and the prestigious position of Children's Laureate.  
  
Despite her success, Wilson remains remarkably humble and grounded, often crediting her readers for inspiring her work and expressing gratitude for the opportunity to connect with them through her stories. Her approachable and down-to-earth demeanor has contributed to her enduring popularity and has endeared her to both young readers and their parents.  
  
Today, Jacqueline Wilson's impact on children's literature is immeasurable, and her books continue to be cherished by readers of all ages. Her ability to tackle challenging themes with sensitivity and empathy, combined with her engaging storytelling and memorable characters, has solidified her reputation as one of the most beloved and influential authors of children's literature. Whether she's navigating the complexities of family dynamics, the challenges of adolescence, or the universal experience of growing up, Wilson's stories resonate with readers on a deep and emotional level, leaving a lasting impression that transcends age and time.

About Gild
----------

Gild is redefining headwear as a wearable, luxury product. Our headwear is based on high-quality, sustainable textiles combined with a modern silhouette devoid of branding or logos. We produce hats that are season-less and multi-functional to fit with our busy lives. As we now wear the same wardrobe to work and then out, consumers are demanding more of fewer items, and Gild is elevating headwear to fit this need.  
  
Gild uses our proprietary AR sizing technology to offer a seamless mobile shopping experience and instill consumer confidence our products will fit perfectly (patent pending). We are one of the few companies who manufacture their own products and control the supply chain from start to finish. Our design and construction is proprietary and fundamentally different than any other hat in market. We offer a complete range of sizes to give a semi-custom fit to every man or woman for the first time, no matter the size of your head.  
  
Headwear is a legacy industry that hasn't changed in decades. Most hats are white labelled by the same manufacturers. This has resulted in the market being saturated with the same cheaply made, ill fitting (one size fits all) hats that are plastered with brands and logos. They are throw away items that make you feel lazy and juvenile. Women and anyone with a head outside of the average male are ignored. Everyone wears hats but we haven't really thought about it until now because a superior product hasn't been offered to challenge the status quo.

His impressive portfolio includes significant contributions to iconic products such as Flight Simulator 2002, Flight Simulator 2004, Flight Simulator X, and Train Simulator 2, showcasing his versatility across various domains. At Microsoft, Rafael has co-led a dynamic four-person team tasked with the ambitious implementation of the WebGL API in Internet Explorer 11. His leadership and technical expertise were pivotal in driving the project's success, as he was individually responsible for critical features such as point size, software fallback, cubemaps, and non-floating point vertex buffers. Under his guidance, the team's conformance rate skyrocketed from 0% to an impressive 85% within just one year, demonstrating his ability to deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment.  
  
Rafael's proficiency spans a wide array of skills, including C, C#, XML, and .NET, complemented by a strong command of Object-Oriented Design principles. His experience with the Windows platform, Win32 API, and Visual Studio further enhances his capability to develop robust software solutions. His deep understanding of gameplay mechanics, audio integration, graphics rendering, and terrain generation has made him a key member of teams responsible for pushing the boundaries of interactive experiences. As he continues to innovate at Microsoft, Rafael remains committed to advancing the intersection of gaming and web technologies, driving forward the evolution of user experiences in the digital landscape.

About Highland Park Plastic Surgery Center
------------------------------------------

Dr. George A. Toledo graduated from the University of Texas in Austin with high honors and a Phi Beta Kappa. He attended Southwestern Medical School in Dallas, graduating in 1980 at the top of his class.  
  
After graduation he spent seven years of post-graduate surgical training consisting of internships and residencies at the following institutions: Baylor University Medical Center, Duke University Medical Center, Louisiana State University Medical Center, and the many hospitals that make up the Texas Medical Center in Houston. While in Houston, Dr. Toledo had the opportunity to train at the prestigious University of Texas M.D. Anderson Cancer Institute.  
  
Board Certified by the American Board of Plastic Surgery as well as the American Board of Otolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery, provides Dr. Toledo added expertise in facial surgery, especially cosmetic and reconstructive surgery of the face and nose. He is a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons and the American Society of Plastic Surgeons as well as a member of many other medical and surgical societies.  
  
Since 1985, Dr. Toledo’s practice has evolved from reconstructive surgery to primarily cosmetic and aesthetic procedures. Today the focus is three fold: the aging face and eyes, breast surgery and body contouring, and rhinoplasties. Dr. Toledo has developed a reputation for treating difficult complications arising from cosmetic surgery throughout the United States and Latin America.

About Hitcents.com
------------------

We’re a premium independent agency specializing in mobile app and game development located in Bowling Green, Kentucky.  
  
Hitcents was founded in 1999 by twin brothers, Clinton and Chris Mills. Still in high school at the time, they were armed with two laptops and just enough raw ambition to make their ideas a reality. Originally created as a cost-per-click advertising business, the company began a new chapter in 2011 by focusing on work for hire web and app development. During that year, an employee had an idea called “Draw A Stickman”. He thought, “how cool would it be to draw your own Stickman and then watch it come to life on screen?”  
  
After a few months, the website www.drawastickman.com was launched, and 10 million visitors stopped by within the first weekend. Something that started as a simple idea designed to promote creativity quickly became a huge success. From this achievement, a new business model and a fresh new direction emerged for Hitcents. We turned our focus to the development of large-scale mobile games, and we’ve been playing in the games arena ever since!  
  
Over the past 17 years, we've remained true to our original development background while continuing to pivot into a variety of industries including mobile games & apps, web development, and software development. Hitcents is based out of our original location in Bowling Green, Kentucky, and over the years we have expanded our offices to San Francisco and Los Angeles.  
  
We’re excited to see where our future growth will take us next!

For those interested in the educators behind this transformative initiative, the Social Innovation + Change Initiative at Harvard Kennedy School features a distinguished teachers list that includes leading scholars and practitioners in the field. About Covera Health
-------------------

At Covera, we’re committed to ensuring high-quality healthcare is more than just a promise. That’s why we’re leading the way in the emerging science of quality, and connecting providers and payers in their shared quest to improve patient outcomes and care quality. By tackling this challenge, we have the ability to impact millions of lives by raising the standard of care nationwide.  
  
Our initial focus is radiology, where an early and accurate diagnosis has a profound impact on the rest of a patient’s care journey. Through our work, which uses clinically-validated science-based tools, we’re helping doctors enhance their care, ensuring patients get the right diagnosis, and enabling the healthcare system to support quality improvement at scale.  
  
Through our clinical intelligence platform, we have launched programs that help people access the most effective care and provide doctors with AI-powered quality insights and tools to enhance their care. Today, Covera is partnered with leading employers, payers and healthcare organizations across the US, including Walmart and Microsoft. And, with a pipeline representing over 25% of insured Americans, we are in the early stages of improving care quality for all patients across the globe.  
  
In August 2021, we raised a $25M Series C financing round with Insight Partners, a leading global venture capital and private equity firm investing in high-growth companies driving transformative change in their industries.

Users are encouraged to experiment with different genres and themes to find their unique voice and connect with readers who share their interests.

About ASCII Media Inc.
----------------------

ASCII Media creates game software and 3D animation for consumer brands, ad agencies and online gamers. Some of the company's growing library of over 400 game engines are developed using Adobe Flash, do not require a download, operate on 99% of all computers and can be customized to meet any client's specific needs. ASCII Media's games reach millions of people across all demographics through some of the most popular online destinations and corporate branded Web sites.  
  
The company's distinction within the game software industry lies in its business model, which focuses on licensing and customizing its library of games, rather than creating games as "works for hire." As a result our clients benefit through faster deployments and more cost effective solutions.  
  
Our strength lies in our team. We have some of the most qualified and talented poeple in the games industry. At over 400 games in our library including Mobile, Console, Handheld, multiplayer and numerous community game software systems that are our sole intellectual property, means that we offer a vast number of solutions for our clients to choose from, regardless of demographic, in record time and below market cost.  
  
ASCII Media has world class experience in Virtual Online Worlds. This technology can easily manage a persistent user-base in the hundreds of thousands of online users. ASCII Media's games have one key element, teamwork. Everyone has to pull their weight or the game does not get done, simple as that. A game could have awesome graphics but terrible game play which is why we have everyone do their part to make the game they want to make while doing their best job. For years to come ASCII Media and its members will always be proud of the work they create.

About Salt River Project
------------------------

Overview  
SRP has built a legacy by delivering water and power to the Phoenix metropolitan area for more than 100 years. Today, we are among the largest public power utilities in the nation and the Phoenix area's largest supplier of raw water, serving more than 2 million businesses and residents in Central Arizona. SRP is committed to helping the Valley of the Sun grow and thrive for the next 100 years.  
  
We are applying innovation with new technology to transform operations for continued success in our second century. Careers at SRP include engineering, finance, information technology and cyber security.  
  
Culture  
As a community-based, not-for-profit organization, we act in the best interest of our customers and the communities we serve. From testing sustainable energy concepts and reducing our environmental footprint to working safer each day and volunteering in the community – our culture is inspired by the pioneering spirit of our founders.  
  
Diversity & Inclusion  
SRP aspires to fully apply the power of diversity and inclusion to build a more equitable and sustainable future for our customers, employees and community. Our commitments to this include 10 diverse Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), serving as a signatory on the ONE Community's OpenAZ UNITY Pledge, and becoming a Certified Autism Center. And while we’re not in it for the awards, SRP has been recently recognized as a Best Company for Diversity by Forbes and Statista.

• These guidelines may be updated and visitor comments and posts may be removed at our discretion.

About MANTECH
-------------

At MANTECH, we make water quality analysis faster, simpler, greener and more informative.  
  
Based in Guelph, Ont., Canada, MANTECH manufactures innovative water quality analysis systems that help industrial facilities, laboratories and utilities deliver clean, safe water and protect the environment.  
  
MANTECH’s portable, online and laboratory systems are easy to use and deliver fast, accurate results without the use of harmful chemicals, providing sustainable water quality solutions that are trusted in more than 40 countries. MANTECH systems analyze thousands of samples every day in industrial and municipal wastewater facilities, pulp and paper mills, food and beverage manufacturing plants, laboratories and municipal drinking water treatment plants.  
  
The PeCOD® Analyzer is MANTECH’s novel photoelectrochemical system for analyzing chemical oxygen demand (COD). It is also an effective tool for monitoring biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) and natural organic matter (NOM). The PeCOD® green-chemistry technology accurately measures and analyzes organic pollutants in less than 15 minutes without the use of dichromate, mercury and other harmful chemicals.  
  
MANTECH is also a leading manufacturer of automated and manual systems for BOD, multi-parameter and titration analysis of soil and water samples.  
  
MANTECH systems enable utilities and industry to make impactful decisions that deliver profitability and sustainability while protecting the environment and public health.  
  
If you would like to learn more about MANTECH please visit www.mantech-inc.com, email [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)
 or call 519-763-4245. You can also follow MANTECH on twitter at https://twitter.com/MANTECH\_INC.

What services does United Way of Greater Milwaukee & Waukesha County provide to support health in the community?

United Way of Greater Milwaukee & Waukesha County focuses on improving health outcomes through various initiatives. These include programs aimed at reducing infant mortality, promoting maternal health, and increasing access to healthcare services. They collaborate with local health organizations to provide resources and support for families, ensuring that everyone has the opportunity to lead a healthy life.

How does United Way address educational challenges in the Greater Milwaukee and Waukesha County area?

United Way is committed to ensuring that every child has access to quality education. They support early childhood education programs, after-school initiatives, and mentorship opportunities that help students succeed academically. By partnering with schools, educators, and community organizations, United Way works to close the achievement gap and provide resources that enhance learning experiences for children and youth.

What initiatives does United Way have in place to promote financial stability for families?

United Way of Greater Milwaukee & Waukesha County promotes financial stability through various programs that provide financial literacy education, job training, and access to resources that help families achieve economic independence. They also support initiatives that assist individuals in navigating benefits and services that can alleviate financial stress, ultimately helping families build a sustainable future.

How can I get involved with United Way of Greater Milwaukee & Waukesha County?

There are several ways to get involved with United Way, including volunteering your time, donating funds, or participating in community events. Individuals can join workplace campaigns, become advocates for local issues, or lend their skills to support various initiatives. For more information on how to get involved, visit their website or contact their volunteer coordinator.

What impact does United Way have on reducing teen pregnancy rates in the community?

United Way of Greater Milwaukee & Waukesha County implements programs aimed at preventing teen pregnancies through education and outreach. They provide resources for teens and their families, focusing on sexual health education, access to reproductive health services, and support for young parents. By fostering community collaboration, United Way works to empower youth with the knowledge and resources they need to make informed decisions.

How does United Way measure its community impact and success?

United Way of Greater Milwaukee & Waukesha County measures its community impact through data collection, program evaluations, and community feedback. They set specific goals for each initiative and track progress over time to assess effectiveness. By collaborating with local partners and stakeholders, United Way ensures that its strategies are data-driven and responsive to the needs of the community, ultimately striving for meaningful and lasting change.

About FC Laser Ltd
------------------

FC Laser Ltd are amongst the largest laser cutting facilities of its type in Europe and are a leading provider of precision laser cutting services.  
  
Based beside the M1 in Derbyshire, our range of services include laser cutting, CNC folding and fabrication/welding. We also offer subcon powder coating and polishing.  
  
We provide more than just a laser cutting service. Our customers demand excellence in customer service and expect their precise and exacting demands are met not just technically but with packaging and delivery on time commitments being held on the same importance.  
  
Our primary facility includes 2No Bystronic 10KW fiber lasers 3No Bystronic 12KW fibre lasers, 2No LT7 3KW fibre tube Cutters and 6No Bystronic press brakes. We also offer a comprehensive range of additional services including Deburring, welding and drill operations.  
  
Our services are 24/7 and include  
  
✤ Laser Cutting - 10-12KW Fiber X5 machines  
✔30mm stainless and aluminium, 25mm mild steel  
✔Sheet sizes up to 6000x2500mm  
✔Stainless processing without cross contamination  
✔Full automation with the ByTower sheet loading & storage system  
  
✤ Tube Laser Cutting – X2 3KW LT7 fibre Tube cutters  
✔150mmØ stainless and aluminium and mild steel  
✔Thickness of cut tolerances dependant on material  
✔Stainless processing without cross contamination  
✔Full automation  
  
  
✤ Folding X6 press brakes  
✔320T Xpert 4M bed  
✔Xpert 150 3M bed  
✔2X Xpert 30T 1M bed  
✔Electric press – Xcite 80  
  
  
✤ Machining & Pemming  
  
✤ MIG & TIG Welding  
  
✤ Assembly  
  
✤ Finishing  
✔Powder coating  
✔Polishing  
✔Deburr  
  
All services are performed under our quality processes of ISOQAR UKAS ISO 9001:2015 and EN1090 execution class 2 standards, and our plant operates to 5S principles.  
  
If you would like a tour of our purpose built facility or further information please visit our web site or twitter @FCLaserltd1

About Taylor Francis

Taylor & Francis Group is an international academic publishing company founded in 1852 by William Francis and Richard Taylor. With over 200 years of experience, Taylor & Francis has grown to become one of the world's leading publishers of scholarly journals, books, ebooks, and reference works. The company employs over 7,000 people and publishes over 2,000 journals and 5,000 new books each year, serving a diverse range of academic disciplines and research communities. With a mission to foster and disseminate high-quality research and knowledge, Taylor & Francis is committed to advancing academic scholarship and facilitating innovation and discovery.  
  
Taylor & Francis Group is known for its commitment to quality and integrity in publishing. The company's extensive portfolio includes some of the most respected and influential journals and books in the academic world. Its publications cover a wide range of subject areas, including humanities, social sciences, behavioral sciences, education, science & technology, engineering, medicine, and more. With a global reach, Taylor & Francis helps connect researchers, scholars, and professionals from all over the world, facilitating the exchange of ideas and the advancement of knowledge.  
  
In addition to traditional print publishing, Taylor & Francis has embraced digital technology to enhance the accessibility and impact of its content. The company's online platform provides researchers and academics with easy access to a vast array of scholarly resources, enabling them to stay up-to-date with the latest developments in their fields. Furthermore, Taylor & Francis offers open access options, allowing authors to make their research freely available to the public, thus promoting greater dissemination and visibility of their work.  
  
As a leading academic publisher, Taylor & Francis is committed to supporting and promoting diversity and inclusivity in research and publishing. The company strives to ensure that its content reflects a wide range of perspectives and experiences, contributing to a more comprehensive and equitable representation of knowledge. Furthermore, Taylor & Francis is dedicated to promoting ethical and responsible research practices, adhering to the highest standards of integrity, transparency, and accountability.  
  
In its ongoing pursuit of excellence, Taylor & Francis remains at the forefront of innovation and transformation in academic publishing. The company continually invests in new technologies and initiatives to enhance the dissemination, discoverability, and impact of scholarly research. By embracing and adapting to the evolving landscape of scholarly communication, Taylor & Francis aims to empower researchers, educators, and institutions to make meaningful contributions to academia and society.  
  
In conclusion, Taylor & Francis Group is a renowned academic publisher with a rich history and a global reach. With a diverse portfolio of high-quality journals, books, and digital resources, the company plays a vital role in advancing scholarship and facilitating the exchange of knowledge. Committed to excellence, integrity, and inclusivity, Taylor & Francis continues to push the boundaries of academic publishing, empowering researchers and academics to make a lasting impact in their fields. As the company looks to the future, it remains dedicated to its mission of enabling the advancement of knowledge and fostering innovation and discovery in academia.

About Coolblue
--------------

Who we are  
Coolblue is one of the largest online shops in the Netherlands & Belgium, and has only one goal: Making customers smile. Some smiles come easily, some take a little extra, but at Coolblue it's all in the details. We charge no shipping costs for our orders. We send our customers a text message as soon as their order has been packed and shipped. We answer all questions on Social Media within 30 minutes. Making customers happy is in our DNA.  
  
  
Our people  
In the last 16 years, Coolblue has grown into a company employing over 5.000 enthusiasts, who generate an annual turnover of 555 million Euros. Coolblue people are young – 27 years on average – extremely motivated and frankly, a bit odd. Struck with a good idea? We will give you the means and the opportunity to work on it. Based in our head office in Rotterdam, we work hard in small teams to improve our processes. Just a little better, every single day.  
  
  
Our history  
Coolblue was created in 1999 by Pieter, Paul & Bart, in one of those typical creative hotspots - a bar in Rotterdam. Three Business students who were fond of MP3 players decided to start their own web shop, with two goals in mind: to become millionaires and to create a company that other companies would see as an example regarding customer service. Within a couple of years Coolblue has turned into an award-winning company, praised for its surprising ways of amazing customers with their obsessive focus on service.

About WorkStep
--------------

WorkStep is the leading employee engagement software solution designed to help HR and Operations reduce employee turnover, increase productivity, and boost engagement for their hourly workforce. Our full-cycle solution allows leaders to gather feedback, take action, and improve long-term retention goals. WorkStep combines data analytics with personalized recommendations to help employers identify factors that contribute to frontline turnover and close the loop with populations in their workforce by segment.  
  
WorkStep's employee experience solution provides comprehensive employee listening, engagement, voice of the employee, and communication functionality including:  
  
\*Employee Feedback: WorkStep collects real-time insights from employees through milestone pulse, always-on, annual surveys, and bi-directional feedback channels.  
  
\*Employee Reporting: Reporting provides HR and Ops leaders with data on employee behavior which can be segmented by various filters including role type, location, demographics and tenure, to identify trends and patterns that may impact retention  
  
\*Predictive Analytics: WorkStep utilizes machine learning to determine the top areas of improvement, at facility or role level, and suggest high-impact actions to reduce employee turnover  
  
\*Impact Analysis: Employers can measure the success of any initiative implemented by tracking the change in employee sentiment and retention across the impacted population  
  
\*Loop Closure: Employers can reply to urgent comments and alerts while maintaining employee anonymity or broadly communicate to segments of the workforce to bring attention to new programs, share critical updates, celebrate teams, or solicit feedback.  
  
By combining data analytics with personalized recommendations, WorkStep helps employers identify and directly address factors that contribute to employee turnover. This results in improved retention rates, increased productivity, and reduced costs.

About Coloplast Interventional Urology
--------------------------------------

Coloplast is a leading global manufacturer and marketer of innovative medical devices for the management and treatment of urological conditions, including stress urinary incontinence, pelvic organ prolapse, kidney stones, erectile dysfunction and testicular replacement. Our signature products include Titan® Penile Implants, Restorelle® Restorelle® Y-Mesh and Flat Mesh, Altis® Single Incision Sling and ReTrace® Access Sheath. We operate our business by upholding the highest standards of quality, business integrity and a commitment to sustainable business practices internally and throughout our supply chain.  
  
Driven by innovation  
We work closely with leading experts around the world to develop products for prosthetic urology, male stress urinary incontinence, endourology and female pelvic medicine procedures. We are committed to listening and responding to our customers’ needs, which has led to a range of devices to simplify procedures and enhance the patient experience. Our state-of-the-art surgical lab helps surgeons test and refine skills and new products. We also provide training and educational resources so you can keep up with the latest techniques.  
  
Supporting sustainable development  
We are committed to minimizing the negative impact on the environment by the production and use of our products. By making smart choices and small changes, we’re making a big difference. Additionally, we have established a sustainable supplier program to ensure environmentally and socially responsible operations, as well as identifying new materials with a smaller footprint.  
  
Learn more about our sustainability commitment: https://sustainability.coloplast.com/sustainability/

A 60-acre public park called, “A Gathering Place” providing entertainment for the entire family includes a five-acre adventure playground, sport courts, bike and skate parks, nature trails and large lawns for concerts.

SARRALLE GROUP is an industrial, privately owned and independent Group, specialized in engineering, design and manufacture of heavy equipment.

Currently present in most active markets in the Global Steel Industry (Europe, USA, India, Brazil, Mexico and others) and having more than 1,000 employees worldwide.  
  
The Group’s vision and strategic policy are oriented towards continuous improvement, search of innovation and solutions for our customers’ needs. SARRALLE GROUP is a milestone in the heavy industry, influencing technological trends, setting new marks and pushing technological limits thanks to a dynamic, highly-qualified and multicultural team.  
  
The Group’s commitment materialises in high-quality service and customer care. Hence, SARRALLE GROUP has established itself as a most reliable partner in long-term relations.  
  
PARS SARRALLE is SARRALLE GROUP'S established branch in IRAN, dedicated to the Steel Melting Industry, offering all kinds of services & solutions to its customers, in Design, Manufacturing, Erection & Commissioning fields.  
  
PARS SARRALLE'S main objective is to give fully integrated European quality and customized solutions to steel making companies according to the group's standards.  
  
\- EP& EPC projects  
\- Spare Parts  
\- Upgrading (revamping) projects  
\- Engineering  
\- Consulting  
\- Maintenance services  
  
PARS SARRALLE is offering Mechanical, Electrical and Control & Automation equipments and services focused on the Steel Making Plant installations:  
  
\- EAF (Electric Arc Furnace)  
\- LF (Ladle Furnace)  
\- CCM (Continuous Casting Machine)  
\- MHS (Material Handling System)  
\- DDP (De-Dusting Plant)

About HNI Corporation
---------------------

At HNI Corporation, we go beyond simply building great desks, chairs, file cabinets and fireplaces. We're focused on building relationships by delivering solutions. With deeply held values that were born with the corporation's founding in 1944, we are a collection of individuals, called members, united by a dedication to integrity, quality, innovation, service and continuous improvement.  
  
HNI Corporation's growth strategy centers on three imperatives: building leading brands, taking care of end users and achieving operational excellence. The corporation's manufacturing and supply chain expertise consistently translates to the highest quality products, provided with the fastest and most dependable turnaround in its industries.  
  
HNI Corporation is a group of companies, each representing a family of leading brands, products and services for the office and home. In HNI Corporation's unique and powerful member-owner environment, every member has an opportunity to share in making the business better. Everyone is rewarded for individual and collective performance through stock ownership, profit sharing and other compensation systems.  
  
Our culture is built around Rapid Continuous Improvement (RCI) and the notion that every member has something unique and valuable to contribute. We have found that when our people share their ideas, and management acts on those ideas, we achieve something powerful: 10,000-plus individuals working actively to make the company better.
